g.text: per-region, per-service FCAS price statistics printed
cmd: just nemosis-fetch DISPATCHPRICE "2025/09/01 00:00:00" "2025/09/08 00:00:00" | pass: prints 'nemosis-fetch: DISPATCHPRICE rows=<N> sha256=<prefix>'
cmd: just nem-fcas | pass: prints a row per region and service, then 'nem-fcas: regions=5 services=8 negative_prices=0' and 'PASS nem-fcas'
